design_decisions.four_dimensions: r4_observed / run_accepted / coverage / stage_qualified are separate keys; there is no merged `passed`
design_decisions.acceptance_rule: every gate in ACCEPTANCE_GATES must be in state pass; absent == not_covered == fail == blocker
design_decisions.why_not_intersect_echo_fields: an intersection would silently stop checking a field the moment one source drops it; fields are declared per comparison and a missing one is a coverage gap
design_decisions.why_not_line_order: the real RNW3 Source writes API/Applied BEFORE the final Decision line; causality uses submit_commit_ns < ready_commit_ns < activation_commit_ns <= api_left_start
design_decisions.old_candidates: absence yields coverage=not_applicable_absent and never blocks and never counts as rejection
